Posterior to the gill slits, there are approximately five discernible horizontal rows of spots. The spatial distribution shows regular inter-blob distancing in both the horizontal and vertical axes within the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands are visible running perpendicular to the longitudinal axis. These bands intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, with the highest-intensity pixel clusters located precisely at these intersection points, creating a coordinate-like matrix.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper and middle thirds of the flank. They are characterized by a sharp luminance gradient, with the upper surfaces reflecting light and the lower surfaces cast in shadow, defining linear trajectories that taper towards the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits several high-luminance blobs. Approximately 5 to 7 spots are visible, distributed primarily along the lower two-thirds of the fin's surface area, though pixel blur reduces the clarity of individual spot margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least four remoras swimming underneath the ventral-lateral area of the shark.
